name: ASSIST Cubing 2020
information: Contributions At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize. More details on http://www.speedcubing.ro Lunch The main sponsor will provide some sandwiches/snacks. You can walk arround at the restaurants and shops. Prizes Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event. Cubes from our sponsor ASSIST.
